name: Zinng
tagline: Zinng is an AI receptionist that answers your business calls around the clock with a natural, friendly voice
description: Zinng is an AI receptionist that answers your business calls around the clock with a natural, friendly voice. It schedules appointments, captures leads, detects emergencies, and sends callers booking links or follow-up texts. Every call is transcribed and organized in a clean inbox alongside your SMS conversations, so you can manage all your customer communication in one place. It connects to your existing tools so leads and appointments flow right into whatever systems you already use. Our team
